Subject: Post-call recap & mutual action plan (Oxbridge Analytics)

Thanks again for taking time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned. I’ve attached a working MPA and a pricing summary for reference.

Key pain points you called out:
- Production latency spikes on batch inference during end-of-day processing (current 95p ~1.8s).
- Token cost variability with bursty peak traffic (~3x delta month-over-month).
- Compliance requirement: logs retained 12+ months with access controls.

Primary goals we discussed:
1) Reduce 95p generation latency to <750ms for the real-time alerting model.
2) Reduce per-token cost by ~30% vs current infra through batching + quantization.
3) Run a 4-week pilot that demonstrates stable latency and cost metrics, with SOC2-aligned controls in place.

Draft Mutual Action Plan (high level) — please confirm owners/dates:
- Pilot kickoff (config + dataset handoff): target week of Jul 8 — Owner: Oxbridge (Ellen) + Redwood (Aditya)
- Pilot run (4 weeks): Jul 15 — Aug 11 — Owner: Oxbridge (Tom) + Redwood SRE (Soojin)
- Security review & SOC2 evidence exchange: complete by Jul 22 — Owner: Oxbridge InfoSec + Redwood Security
- Contract & PO: sign by Jul 29 — Owner: Oxbridge Procurement + Redwood Sales

Asks / open items for you: 
- Confirm primary decision-makers (technical, procurement, exec sponsor).
- Share sample inference load profile (hourly QPS for last 30 days) and a small representative test dataset (anonymized).
- Procurement timeline and PO process so we can align pricing/commit dates.

Attachments: oxbridge-mpa-draft.xlsx (MPA table you can edit), redwood-pricing-2028.pdf (reference pricing tiers).

If that looks right I’ll have Soojin drop in a more detailed pilot runbook and a short config proposal for Dedicated vs Hosted ramps.

Thanks — Aditya

Subject: Re: Post-call recap & mutual action plan (Oxbridge Analytics) — Pilot runbook + config notes

Hi Ellen / Tom — quick technical follow-up and a suggested pilot schedule below. I’ve attached a filled MPA tab with more granular milestones.

High-level approach (recommended):
- Environment: Start Hosted API with a Dedicated pool reserve at 4x baseline QPS for pilot burst protection. If predictable, convert to Dedicated capacity after pilot.
- Model config: 8-bit quantization for the customer model variants (saves ~25–35% tokens cost). We’ll use continuous batching with 20–40ms batch windows to keep P95 < 750ms in most patterns; fallback single-request low-latency route for spikes.
- Security: Logs retained in US region only; we’ll provide a signed data residency addendum. SOC2 artifacts: audit logs, access matrix, and KMS key policy extract — Redwood can provide packaged evidence within 3 business days of request.

Refined MPA milestones (dates editable):
1) Jul 8 — Kickoff + dataset handoff (Ellen, Tom / Aditya, Soojin)
2) Jul 9–12 — Dry-run + config validation (Redwood)
3) Jul 15–Aug 11 — Pilot execution (metrics gating: 95p latency < 750ms; cost delta target -30%)
4) Jul 22 — Security evidence exchange complete
5) Jul 25 — Pilot review / exec demo
6) Jul 29 — Contract signature / PO issuance

Open technical asks from our side:
- Representative anonymized inference dataset (100–500 examples) + sample QPS export.
- Any red-team or allowed-prompt constraints we should be aware of during pilot.

Attachment: oxbridge-mpa-draft.xlsx — completed "Pilot runbook" tab and a short configuration checklist.

Happy to jump on a short tech touch tomorrow if you want to walk the runbook.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
